Introduction Refrigerants are found in nearly every building. They are the workhorses of most heating, ventilating, and air-conditioning (HVAC) and refrigeration systems. They play a crucial role in air-conditioning systems, refrigeration equipment, water coolers, ice makers, dehumidifiers, heat pumps, and more. Figure 1 shows a sample of common locations for refrigerants in and around a facility. Some equipment, such as refrigerators and ice makers, come with refrigerant preinstalled at the time of equipment manufacture, while other equipment such as variable refrigerant flow HVAC systems may require the refrigerant to be added during equipment installation.
